AI Factories & GPU Clusters

### From One GPU Server to a Full AI Factory

We design GPU clusters around your models and throughput targets, then deliver them as integrated, tested racks. Choose rack-scale NVLink systems for the largest models or HGX and PCIe servers for flexible enterprise AI.

- NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72, GB300 NVL72 and HGX B300 / B200 platforms

- Rail-optimised InfiniBand (Quantum-X800) or Spectrum-X Ethernet fabrics

- Slurm, Kubernetes, NVIDIA Base Command Manager and Mission Control

- NVIDIA AI Enterprise, NIM microservices and MLOps tooling

- Liquid cooling design: CDUs, manifolds and facility integration

Design My Cluster

High-Performance Computing

### HPC Clusters for Science and Engineering

Plug-and-play HPC clusters for CFD, FEA, weather, seismic and life sciences, combining GPU-accelerated nodes, high-core-count CPU nodes and low-latency interconnects.

- Supermicro SuperBlade, BigTwin and GrandTwin, and ASUS high-density nodes

- InfiniBand fabric with in-network computing

- Parallel file systems on all-flash NVMe storage

- Job scheduling, user environments and application tuning

Plan an HPC Cluster

Server Clustering & High Availability

### Keep Critical Services Running

We build clustered server environments that survive hardware failures and scale out as you grow, for databases, ERP, web platforms and internal applications.

- Failover clusters: VMware vSphere HA, Windows Server Failover Clustering, Proxmox

- Hyperconverged infrastructure: vSAN, Nutanix, Azure Local

- Kubernetes and OpenShift container platforms

- Load balancing, shared storage and replication across sites

- Backup and disaster recovery with Veeam

Discuss Clustering

- Colocation: rack space, power, cooling and remote hands

- Managed hosting with monitoring, patching and backups

## Services (https://planman.ae/services.html)

Home / Services

Services

## From Requirements to After-Sales Support

We cover every stage of your project: understanding the requirement, designing the solution, supplying the hardware, deploying it and supporting it for years after go-live.

### Our Services

#### Requirement Analysis & Design

Site surveys, stakeholder workshops, solution architecture, bill of materials and budget planning.

- GPU, CPU and memory sizing

- Network topology and fabric design

- Rack elevation and facility requirements

#### System & Rack Integration

We build, configure and validate systems at server, rack and cluster level before shipping to site.

- L10 system, L11 rack and L12 cluster integration

- Firmware baselining and BIOS tuning

- Burn-in, NCCL and HPL acceptance testing

#### Onsite Deployment

Rack and stack, structured cabling, fabric bring-up and OS and software stack installation at your data center.

- Copper, fibre and optics labelling

- InfiniBand and Ethernet fabric bring-up

- Handover documentation

#### Liquid Cooling Integration

Direct liquid cooling for high-density GPU racks: CDU selection, manifolds, facility water and commissioning.

- Liquid-to-liquid and liquid-to-air CDUs

- Rear-door heat exchangers

- Leak detection and monitoring

#### Clustering & Platform Setup

Configured, production-ready platforms on top of the hardware we deliver.

- Slurm, Kubernetes and GPU Operator

- VMware, Proxmox, Nutanix and Hyper-V HA clusters

- NVIDIA AI Enterprise and vGPU licensing

#### Hosting & Colocation

Run your infrastructure in a UAE data center with our team handling the physical layer.

- Dedicated and bare-metal GPU servers

- Rack space, power and remote hands

- Private GPU cloud environments

#### Managed Services

Ongoing operation of your environment with monitoring, patching and lifecycle management.

- 24/7 health and performance monitoring

- Firmware and driver lifecycle

- Capacity planning and expansion

#### After-Sales Support

Local support after handover: warranty claims, vendor RMA, maintenance and upgrades to keep downtime to a minimum.

- Local spares stocking options

- Vendor warranty and RMA handling

- Onsite break-fix

#### Enterprise Hardware Supply

Complete servers, storage, GPUs, networking and workstations from all premium brands, for end customers, resellers and integrators.

- Dell, HPE, Lenovo, Cisco, NVIDIA and more

- Project and bulk pricing

- Export and regional logistics

Built for Density

### Liquid-Cooled, Rack-Ready, Tested

Modern GPU racks draw more power than air alone can cool. We plan direct liquid cooling and power delivery with your facility team, then integrate and test every rack before it ships, so installation day is about plugging in, not troubleshooting.

- CDU sizing, manifolds and facility water loops

- Rack-level power, cabling and firmware baselines

- Burn-in and performance validation before shipping

Plan a Deployment

## About (https://planman.ae/about.html)

About Plan Man

## The Engine for Your Digital Success

A Dubai-based solution provider and enterprise hardware supplier for hospitality groups, universities, manufacturers and enterprises.

Who We Are

### Solution Provider. Hardware Supplier. Long-Term Partner.

Plan Man helps organisations across the UAE plan, build and run their IT infrastructure. We focus on hospitality, education, manufacturing and corporate enterprise, supplying complete servers, storage, GPUs and networking from all premium brands.

Our role goes beyond selling hardware. We gather your requirements, design the right solution, supply and deploy it, and stay with you through after-sales support, whether it's a new hotel, a university AI lab or a factory server room.

Explore our services

What We Do

### Three Ways We Work With You

#### Solution Design

We gather requirements and design complete solutions, from a single server room to multi-site infrastructure and AI clusters.

#### Deployment & Support

We install, configure and hand over, then stay on with after-sales support, maintenance and upgrades.

#### Enterprise Hardware Sales

We supply complete servers, storage, GPUs and networking from all premium brands to end customers, resellers and integrators.

#### Our Vision

To be the region's most trusted partner for AI and data center infrastructure, helping every organisation turn accelerated computing into real business outcomes.

#### Our Mission

To deliver reliable, secure and high-performance infrastructure, designed with care, integrated with precision and supported locally, so our clients can focus on innovation.

Leadership Message

“At Plan Man, we strive to be at the forefront of technological innovation. Our team is passionate about delivering reliable and advanced IT solutions that empower your business. Focusing on the UAE's thriving markets, we provide tailored solutions that handle local demands. We value your trust and are committed to building lasting relationships with our clients and partners.”
Plan Man Leadership Team

## Frequently asked questions

### What does Plan Man do?

Plan Man is a Dubai-based enterprise IT solutions provider and hardware supplier. We handle IT projects end to end: requirement analysis, solution design, hardware supply, deployment and after-sales support, for hospitality groups, universities, manufacturers and enterprises across the UAE.

### Which hardware brands does Plan Man supply?

We supply complete servers, storage, GPUs, networking, workstations and power equipment from premium enterprise brands including Dell, HPE, Lenovo, NVIDIA, Supermicro, ASUS, Cisco, NetApp, Pure Storage, Synology, QNAP, Seagate, Western Digital, AMD, Intel, APC and Eaton.

### Does Plan Man supply NVIDIA GPU servers and AI infrastructure in the UAE?

Yes. We supply and integrate NVIDIA-based AI infrastructure, from RTX PRO and HGX B200/B300 GPU servers to rack-scale GB300 NVL72 systems from Supermicro and ASUS, and we design and deploy GPU clusters, AI labs and inference platforms.

### Which industries does Plan Man work with?

We focus on hospitality (hotels, resorts and hotel groups), universities and education, manufacturing and industrial sites, and corporate enterprises in the UAE.

### Does Plan Man provide installation and after-sales support?

Yes. Our team handles installation, configuration, migration, testing and handover, and continues with after-sales support including warranty and RMA handling, maintenance and upgrades.

### Where is Plan Man located and how do I request a quote?

Plan Man is located at IFZA Properties, Dubai Silicon Oasis (DSO), Dubai, UAE. Call or WhatsApp +971 58 522 5166, email sales@planmanme.com, or send your requirements through the contact form at https://planman.ae/contact.html. We reply within one business day.

## Product catalog (AI and data center platforms)

Specifications summarised from public vendor information; final configurations are confirmed with a quote.

### Rack-Scale AI Systems

#### NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 (NVIDIA)

Page: https://planman.ae/products/nvidia-vera-rubin-nvl72.html

Next-generation rack-scale platform for agentic AI and reasoning, unifying 72 Rubin GPUs and 36 Vera CPUs in a single NVLink domain.

NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 is a rack-scale AI supercomputer that joins 72 Rubin GPUs and 36 Vera CPUs, together with ConnectX-9 SuperNICs and BlueField-4 DPUs, in a single sixth-generation NVLink domain. It is designed for AI factories that train and serve trillion-parameter, mixture-of-experts and long-context reasoning models.

The platform is built on the third-generation NVIDIA MGX NVL72 rack with cable-free modular trays and is supported by more than 80 ecosystem partners, so the same architecture is available as NVIDIA DGX and from server makers such as Supermicro and ASUS.

Compute:
- GPUs: 72× NVIDIA Rubin
- CPUs: 36× NVIDIA Vera
- Total NVIDIA + HBM4 chips: 1,296

AI performance:
- NVFP4 inference: 3,600 PFLOPS
- NVFP4 training: 2,520 PFLOPS
- FP8/FP6 training: 1,260 PFLOPS
- FP16/BF16: 288 PFLOPS
- TF32: 144 PFLOPS
- FP32: 9,360 TFLOPS
- FP64: 2,400 TFLOPS

Memory & interconnect:
- GPU memory: 20.7 TB HBM4
- GPU memory bandwidth: 1,400 TB/s
- CPU memory: Up to 54 TB LPDDR5X
- NVLink bandwidth: 216 TB/s
- NVLink-C2C bandwidth: 65 TB/s
- Networking bandwidth: 32.4 TB/s (bi-directional)

Infrastructure:
- Rack: Third-generation NVIDIA MGX NVL72, liquid-cooled
- Inlet temperature: 45 °C
- Networking: ConnectX-9 SuperNICs, BlueField-4 DPUs
- Scale-out fabric: Quantum-X800 InfiniBand or Spectrum-X Ethernet

Use cases: Agentic AI and deep-reasoning inference, Long-context LLM serving, Mixture-of-experts training, Trillion-parameter post-training, AI factories for cloud and sovereign AI, Scientific computing and AI for science.

Source: NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 (https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/data-center/vera-rubin-nvl72/)

#### NVIDIA DGX Vera Rubin NVL72 (NVIDIA)

Page: https://planman.ae/products/nvidia-dgx-vera-rubin-nvl72.html

Turnkey, ready-to-deploy enterprise AI infrastructure built on the Vera Rubin platform and managed with NVIDIA Mission Control.

NVIDIA DGX Vera Rubin NVL72 is the turnkey, NVIDIA-built implementation of the Vera Rubin NVL72 platform: 72 Rubin GPUs and 36 Vera CPUs delivered as a complete, ready-to-deploy rack for training and long-context inference at scale.

It is the building block of NVIDIA DGX SuperPOD and ships with NVIDIA Mission Control, NVIDIA AI Enterprise and DGX OS, backed by three years of enterprise business-standard support for hardware and software.

Compute:
- GPUs: 72× NVIDIA Rubin
- CPUs: 36× NVIDIA Vera
- GPU memory: 20.7 TB HBM4
- GPU memory bandwidth: 1,400 TB/s

Performance:
- NVFP4 inference: 3,600 PFLOPS
- NVFP4 training: 2,520 PFLOPS (dense)
- FP8/FP6 training: 1,260 PFLOPS (dense)

Networking:
- Compute fabric: 144+ single-port NVIDIA ConnectX-9 VPI, 800 Gb/s InfiniBand and Ethernet
- DPUs: 18× dual-port NVIDIA BlueField-4 VPI, 400 Gb/s InfiniBand and Ethernet
- NVLink: 9× L1 NVIDIA NVLink Switches
- Management: Host baseboard management controller (RJ45)

Software & support:
- Software: NVIDIA Mission Control, NVIDIA AI Enterprise, NVIDIA DGX OS
- Support: Three years enterprise business-standard (hardware and software)

Use cases: Frontier and foundation model training, Long-context enterprise inference, Reasoning and agentic AI, Turnkey AI factories and DGX SuperPOD.

Source: NVIDIA DGX Vera Rubin NVL72 (https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/data-center/dgx-vera-rubin-nvl72/)

#### NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 (NVIDIA)

#### ASUS XA NB3I-E12 (ASUS)

Page: https://planman.ae/products/asus-xa-nb3i-e12.html
Model: XA NB3I-E12

9U NVIDIA HGX B300 8-GPU server with dual Intel Xeon 6 for heavy AI training and inference.

The ASUS XA NB3I-E12 is a 9U server built around the NVIDIA HGX B300 8-GPU board and dual Intel Xeon 6 processors. Eight ConnectX-8 adapters are embedded on the GPU board, giving each GPU an 800 Gb/s XDR InfiniBand link.

A modular design with minimal internal cabling speeds assembly and improves airflow, and 5+5 redundant Titanium power supplies keep it efficient under heavy AI load.

Processor & memory:
- CPUs: 2× Intel Xeon 6 (6700P), up to 350 W

- Ports: 144

Page: https://planman.ae/products/nvidia-connectx-8.html

SuperNIC delivering up to 800 Gb/s for InfiniBand or Ethernet GPU-to-GPU networking.

The NVIDIA ConnectX-8 SuperNIC delivers up to 800 Gb/s of network bandwidth per adapter for GPU-to-GPU communication in large AI clusters. It supports both InfiniBand (XDR) and Ethernet, and is the standard compute-fabric NIC in Blackwell Ultra systems.

A PCIe Gen6 host interface with up to 48 lanes and an integrated PCIe switch let one ConnectX-8 serve GPUs, CPUs and storage without extra switch chips.

- Maximum bandwidth: 800 Gb/s

- Host interface: PCIe Gen6, up to 48 lanes (Gen5 / Gen4 compatible)
- Form factors: PCIe HHHL 1× OSFP; PCIe HHHL 2× QSFP112; dual ConnectX-8 mezzanine; OCP 3.0 TSFF 1× OSFP

Use cases: East-west GPU compute fabric, Blackwell and Blackwell Ultra clusters, Quantum-X800 and Spectrum-X networks, Hyperscale AI factories.

#### Supermicro CloudDC Servers (Supermicro)

Page: https://planman.ae/products/smc-cloud-dc.html

Cost-optimised single- and dual-socket servers for cloud and hosting providers.

Supermicro CloudDC is an all-in-one 1U/2U platform for cloud data centers, built on the OCP Data Center Modular Hardware System (DC-MHS) standard. It offers flexible I/O and storage with dual AIOM (OCP 3.0) slots for high network throughput.

Tool-less, hot-swap serviceability and single- or dual-socket Intel Xeon 6 or AMD EPYC options make it a cost-optimised building block for hosting and cloud service providers.

Platform:
- CPUs: Intel Xeon 6700 / 6500 or AMD EPYC 9005 / 9004, single or dual socket
- Form factor: 1U / 2U
- Expansion: 2 or 4 PCIe 5.0 x16 slots plus dual AIOM (OCP 3.0)

- GPU: Up to 2 single-width GPUs
- Standard: OCP DC-MHS

- SYS-122C-TN: 1U, Intel Xeon 6, dual socket
- AS -1116CS-TN: 1U, AMD EPYC 9005 / 9004

#### Supermicro BigTwin & GrandTwin (Supermicro)

Page: https://planman.ae/products/smc-twin.html

Multi-node servers with shared power and cooling for high-density compute and HCI clusters.

Supermicro Twin systems place several independent server nodes in one 2U chassis that share redundant Titanium-level power supplies and cooling. This raises compute density and lowers cost and power per node.

BigTwin provides four dual-processor nodes in 2U for performance-focused clusters, while GrandTwin provides four single-processor nodes with front or rear I/O for scale-out cloud, HCI and HPC.

GrandTwin:
- Nodes: 2U, 4 single-socket nodes
- CPUs: AMD EPYC 9005 / 9004 (up to 192 cores) or Intel Xeon, per model
- Memory: Up to 4 TB DDR5 per node
- Storage: 4 to 6 hot-swap NVMe / SATA bays per node
- Power: 2200 W redundant Titanium (model dependent)

BigTwin:
- Nodes: 2U, 4 dual-socket nodes
- Storage: Up to 24× 2.5" or 12× 3.5" NVMe / SAS / SATA per chassis
- Power: Redundant Titanium-level power supplies

Models:
- AS -2116GT-HNTF: GrandTwin 2U 4-node, AMD EPYC 9005 / 9004
- AS -2115GT-HNTR: GrandTwin 2U 4-node, rear I/O, 6 bays per node
- SYS-211GT-HNC8F: GrandTwin 2U 4-node, Intel Xeon Scalable

Use cases: HPC clusters, Hyper-converged infrastructure, Cloud and hosting, Virtualization farms.

#### Supermicro SuperBlade & MicroBlade (Supermicro)

Page: https://planman.ae/products/smc-superblade.html

Blade architectures with integrated switching for maximum density and energy efficiency.

Supermicro SuperBlade and MicroBlade are blade architectures that share power, cooling, networking and management across many server nodes in one enclosure, cutting cabling and energy use while maximising density.

SuperBlade targets HPC and enterprise clusters with Intel Xeon 6 blades and optional liquid cooling; MicroBlade targets ultra-dense, scale-out cloud with low-power processors.

8U SuperBlade:
- Nodes: Up to 20 blades
- CPUs: Intel Xeon 6700 / 6500
- Memory: Up to 16 DDR5 MRDIMM 8000 MT/s per blade
- Rack density: Up to 120 nodes per 48U rack
- Cooling: Air or optional liquid cooling

6U SuperBlade:
- Nodes: Up to 10 blades
- CPUs: Intel Xeon 6900 series options
- Cooling: Air or liquid cooling

6U MicroBlade:
- Nodes: Up to 20 server blades
- Networking: 2 Ethernet switches, 2 management modules
- Rack density: Up to 320 nodes per 48U rack
- Redundancy: N+N

Use cases: HPC clusters, Private cloud, Cloud service providers, Enterprise data centers, SAP HANA (certified configurations).

Source: Supermicro SuperBlade (https://www.supermicro.com/en/products/superblade); Supermicro MicroBlade (https://www.supermicro.com/en/products/microblade)

### Storage

#### Supermicro All-Flash NVMe Storage (Supermicro)

Page: https://planman.ae/products/smc-petascale.html

Petascale all-flash NVMe servers built to feed GPU clusters and AI data pipelines.

Supermicro Petascale servers are all-flash NVMe storage systems built around EDSFF E3.S drives. A symmetrical layout keeps signal paths short and airflow even, so they can feed GPU clusters and AI data pipelines with high throughput and low latency.

They are used as the building block for software-defined and parallel file systems, and are available with Intel Xeon, AMD EPYC or NVIDIA Grace CPU Superchip processors.

1U Petascale:
- Drive bays: Up to 16 hot-swap E3.S, or 8 E3.S plus 4 E3.S 2T (CXL)
- Capacity: Up to 256 TB with current E3.S Gen 5 drives

2U Petascale:
- Drive bays: Up to 32 hot-swap E3.S
- Capacity: Up to about 0.5 PB, rising to 1 PB with 30 TB-class drives
- Sockets: Single- and dual-processor models

Platform:
- CPUs: Intel Xeon, AMD EPYC or NVIDIA Grace CPU Superchip, per model
- I/O: PCIe 5.0
- Memory: DDR5
- Example model: SSG-222B-NE3X24R

Use cases: AI training data storage, Parallel file systems (WEKA, DDN, VAST and others), Data lakes, High-performance databases, Media workflows.

Source: Supermicro X14 Petascale datasheet (https://www.supermicro.com/datasheet/datasheet_X14_Petascale.pdf); Petascale with NVIDIA Grace (https://www.supermicro.com/en/products/petascale-grace-storage)

#### NVIDIA Virtual GPU (vGPU) (NVIDIA)

Page: https://planman.ae/products/nvidia-vgpu.html

Share data center GPUs across virtual desktops, workstations and compute VMs.

NVIDIA virtual GPU (vGPU) software creates virtual GPUs from physical data center GPUs, so many virtual machines can share one GPU, or one VM can use several. Users get near bare-metal performance while IT keeps desktops, data and security centralised.

The latest vGPU release adds support for the RTX PRO 4500 Blackwell Server Edition, and integrates with the leading virtualization platforms.

Editions:
- NVIDIA RTX Virtual Workstation (vWS): For designers, engineers, creators and AI developers
- NVIDIA Virtual PC (vPC) and Virtual Applications (vApps): For knowledge workers and published applications

Platform:
- Hypervisors: Citrix, Nutanix, VMware and other supported platforms
- Supported GPUs: NVIDIA data center GPUs, including RTX PRO Blackwell Server Edition and L40S
- Licensing: Enterprise licensing; free 90-day evaluation

Use cases: Virtual desktops (VDI), CAD, CAE and GIS virtual workstations, AI development in VMs, Digital twins, Graphics-accelerated productivity apps.

Source: NVIDIA virtual GPU solutions (https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/data-center/virtual-solutions/)

#### ASUS Control Center Data Center Edition (ASUS)

Page: https://planman.ae/products/asus-acc.html

Centralised IT management for ASUS servers — monitoring, firmware updates and remote control at scale.

ASUS Control Center Data Center Edition is a unified management platform for HPC, AI and enterprise infrastructure. From one dashboard it monitors hardware health, power and carbon emissions, automates updates and secures mixed server fleets.

It works out-of-band through the ASMB BMC on ASUS servers and scales to thousands of nodes.

Capabilities:
- Monitoring: Real-time hardware and sensor health, VM and storage checks, hourly trend reports
- Automation: BIOS-to-OS patching, task scheduler, group-based management
- Security: MFA, RBAC, IP access control, software blacklists, security reports
- Sustainability: Node, rack and facility power metering; monthly carbon emission reports
- Reporting: Custom dashboards, hardware inventory and software usage reports, audit-ready logs
- Visualisation: POD View 3D server room map
- Out-of-band: ASUS ASMB BMC integration

Use cases: Fleet management across data centers, AI and HPC cluster operations, Firmware lifecycle management, Energy and ESG reporting.
